title: Paul Hellyer: dying Canadian emergency management head sat inside a craft at Area 51
place_text: Bradford, Ontario; Langley, Virginia; Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: go wrong. And he said, "I got taken to Washington to Langley. I signed my life away and then they took me to Area 51 and I sat inside a craft."

plain: A dying man who had headed Canada's emergency management office is said to have confessed that he was taken to Langley, Virginia, home of the CIA, the US spy agency, where he "signed my life away", and then flown to Area 51, a secret US military base in Nevada, where he sat inside a craft. Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, relays this from Paul Hellyer, a former Canadian defence minister, who heard the confession. If true, it would mean the US held a craft and showed it to a senior Canadian official under oath of secrecy.
